errata.error: The dataset's `time_coverage_start` says 2000, but no gauge has values before October 2006.
errata.response: Backfills start from each gauge's first value, not the dataset's coverage.
errata.evidence: The ERDDAP dataset's global `time_coverage_start` attribute; the earliest value at any gauge, found while backfilling, is October 2006 at Skerries Harbour.
errata.report: Sent to the Marine Institute on 2026-11-08; they replied they'll work through it after a period of leave. Text in [#59](https://github.com/openwatersio/water-levels/issues/59).

errata.error: On 24 March 2026 the network moved LAT by 1 to 5 cm at its gauges without noting it in the dataset; OD Malin is unbroken.
errata.response: Levels are in OD Malin, unaffected. `datums` gives only the current LAT, so a level from before 24 March 2026 converted with it is on the new LAT, not the one in use then.
errata.evidence: LAT less OD Malin is constant at each gauge from 2008 until 24 March 2026, then moves by 1 to 5 cm. See [the adapter's README](https://github.com/openwatersio/water-levels/blob/main/src/sources/marine-institute/README.md).
errata.report: Sent to the Marine Institute on 2026-11-08 with [#59](https://github.com/openwatersio/water-levels/issues/59); they replied they'll work through it after a period of leave.

errata.error: The Marine Institute's Castletownbere levels step by up to 1.3 m on and off from 4 February to 25 April 2026.
errata.response: 4 February to 25 April 2026 is flagged `suspect` whole, keeping the source's own flag as `source_flag`, since the offsets come and go within it.
errata.evidence: Found by running GESLA's datum-jump rule (`datumJumps` in `src/sources/gesla`, a 30-day median shift of more than 0.75 m) over every record the lake lists as coastal, and confirmed, November 2026, by daily-mean differences against GESLA's CMEMS and Marine Institute copies of the gauge, which agree with the series to within 2 cm before and after: over the spans the series differs from them by up to 1.3 m.
